## About
Colton's Auto Body is a small shop on SE McLoughlin Blvd in Milwaukie. We do auto body and collision repair, insurance or non-insurance, along with painting, dent repair, custom restorations and some light mechanical work.
Our technician is the owner. Reviewers know him as Del, and they talk about how he explains the repair and how insurance works, and how he looks for ways to save them money without cutting corners. One customer said, "You would never know it had been hit."
We serve Milwaukie, Portland, Gladstone, Oregon City and Clackamas, and we're rated 4.9 from 82 Google reviews. We may not be related, but you'll feel like we're family.

## Services
- Collision and Auto Body Repair: From fender benders to major accident damage, we restore your vehicle to pre-accident condition.
- Auto Painting: Full paint jobs, spot painting and refinishing with professional-grade equipment.
- Custom & Classic Car Restoration: Attention to detail for unique and vintage vehicles.
- Dent & Ding Repair: No job is too small. Every repair gets the same level of care.
- Light Mechanical Work: Brakes, alternators, starters and more.
- Insurance Repair & Claims Assistance: We work with insurance companies to make the process smooth.
- Detailing Services: To get your car looking sharp inside and out.

## FAQ
Q: Do you take insurance and non-insurance jobs?
A: Yes. We welcome auto body and collision repair work either way, and we work with insurance companies to keep the process smooth.

Q: Can you help with my deductible?
A: We can often work with your deductible. Bring your car in and we'll talk it through.

Q: Can I drop off my car outside regular hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Sunday or evening drop off or estimate is available by appointment.

Q: Do you work on motorcycles and classics?
A: Yes. We handle everything from modern cars to motorcycles and classics.

Q: Can you help if my car is a total loss?
A: Contact Del first and he can assist with total loss claims.
